description: Research r10 (dev only): A 002's recipe (A 001 + fp32 master weights at lr 1e-6, cosine decay to 1e-7 over the budget, zero-advantage rows skipped, the verifier's -0.1 for truncated outputs) with mean-centred advantages (adv_norm none, Dr. GRPO) instead of the per-group z-score: in a group with no correct answer the -0.1 then pushes toward shorter outputs at its own scale instead of at full scale, so early searches may survive (as with malformed reward 0) while truncation stays penalized (unlike malformed reward 0).
